author: TED
description: Busy schedules, quiet group chats and no one's sure who should text first. Sound familiar? On this episode of Corner Piece, host Melissa Fernandes asks psychologist Marisa Franco why friendship gets so complicated as we get older, and what we can do to build closer connections. Visit the https://link.mgln.ai/XDgYs3 to listen to the full episode. (edited)
title: Is this why adult friendships feel so hard?
